card.name: Diarrhea in the C. difficile warning
card.fires_on: The word diarrhea in the standard C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning, in the sentence 'CDAD must be considered in all patients who present with diarrhea following antibiotic use'. It also fires on the 'AD' ending of CDAD in that sentence.

modes.label: Diarrhea after 'present with'
modes.description: The word diarrhea in the CDAD sentence, just before 'following antibacterial use'.
modes.example: CDAD must be considered in all patients who present with<< diarrhea>> following antibacterial use.

modes.label: End of CDAD
modes.description: The last piece of the abbreviation CDAD at the start of that sentence.
modes.example: of C. difficile cause increased morbidity and mortality, as these infections can be refractory to antimicrobial therapy and may require colectomy. CD<<AD>> must be considered in all patients who present

card.plain: It marks the diarrhea wording in the standard warning about C. difficile colitis after antibiotic use.
